title: AdminUser
description: Admin operator account. Source: docs/EDD.md §4.9; docs/SCHEMA.md §2.10 admin_users. Renamed from legacy admin_accounts (commit 27e2ab5). Never hard-deleted (audit_logs.admin_id FK requires the row).

username.description: Login identifier (UNIQUE uq_admin_users_username). Used as the credential for login alongside password and TOTP.

passwordHash.description: bcrypt hash of the password. Min work factor: 12.

totpSecretEncrypted.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted TOTP secret. NULL until TOTP enrollment is completed; first login returns TOTP_SETUP_REQUIRED until set.

totpBackupCodesHash.description: Array of SHA-256 hashes of the 10 single-use backup codes. Consumed entry removed on use. NULL until enrollment.

role.description: Admin role. Drives RBAC permission resolution.

lastLoginAt.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent successful login. NULL until the first successful login.

failedAttempts.description: Consecutive failed-login counter (chk_admin_users_failed_attempts_nonneg). Reset to 0 on successful login.

lockedUntil.description: Lockout expiry. Non-NULL and in future = account is temporarily locked (10 failures triggers 30-minute lock).

deactivatedAt.description: Soft-deactivation timestamp. Non-NULL = account permanently deactivated; login blocked. Row is never hard-deleted.

updatedAt.description: Updated by application on every mutation (password, TOTP, role, lockout, deactivation).
